caption: The drawing shows a single, vertically-oriented object positioned centrally within a rectangular frame. The object resembles a decorative container, possibly a salt or pepper shaker, with a rounded base that tapers inward and then outward to form a bulbous lower section. The middle section curves upward and narrows before flaring out again to meet a removable, perforated lid. The lid has a domed, elongated shape and contains patterned holes for dispensing, topped with a small, finial-like ornament. The surface of the main body of the object is smooth, with a monogram or ornate lettering engraved on it. The entire drawing is rendered in grayscale pencil, with shading to indicate contours and metallic reflectivity. The drawing is bordered by a thin rectangular line, and the background is plain and unshaded. The artist's name, "JEAN L. WESTENDORF," is written in small text at the bottom left of the drawing within the frame.
title: Silver Salt Cellar
